selection_approach_display: UEA checks academic eligibility, then ranks eligible applicants by UCAT cognitive total within separate Home and International applicant pools.

course.name: MBBS Medicine
course.notes: Standard-entry A100 Medicine. UEA A101 Graduate Entry Medicine and A104 Gateway Medicine are separate courses and are not implemented as subgroups inside this A100 profile.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Eligible Home A100 applicants are ranked by UCAT cognitive total when interview capacity is oversubscribed. No contextual A100 adjustment is applied.

International A100 applicants follow the same published admissions methodology, with places allocated against a separate International quota. International-only UCAT historical statistics are not published in the supplied evidence.

overall_policy.description: UEA checks GCSE, post-16, UCAT and non-academic threshold requirements before ranking eligible applicants for interview by UCAT cognitive total when the interview pool is oversubscribed. GCSEs and predicted grades are not scored.
not_eligible_if: The supported GCSE threshold is not met.
The supported A-level or IB academic route is not met.
A current-cycle UCAT cognitive total is not supplied.
A required English science A-level practical endorsement is not passed.
An International applicant does not satisfy IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in each component or an accepted exemption.
The applicant is applying as a graduate-entry Medicine applicant, which belongs to UEA A101 rather than A100.
manual_review_if: The applicant is using a Scottish exception route that is not fully represented automatically, such as National 5 bypass, Standard Grade evidence, a mixed qualification combination or an Advanced Higher resit.
The applicant is using country-specific international qualifications without verified UEA equivalence.
The applicant is a resit applicant because UEA's resit rule depends on subject-level resit evidence not fully represented by the generic route.

qualification_scope: National 5 subject equivalents for manual Scottish review

grade_requirements.notes: English Language may sit outside the six GCSE subjects at grade 7/A or above.

science_requirement.notes: Two science subjects or Double Science satisfy the science threshold. GCSE sciences are checked only as a threshold, never scored.

gcse.sitting_policy: GCSE resits are recorded as allowed only when actively resitting and predicted to achieve the required grade; ApplySmart routes detailed resit cases to manual review.
gcse.notes: GCSEs are threshold-only. UEA FOI evidence confirms GCSEs are not scored.

grade_requirements.notes: National 5 Mathematics must be grade A. Lifeskills Mathematics is not accepted.

science_requirement.notes: At least two National 5 science subjects must be grade A.

national_5.notes: Executable standard National 5 route: at least six subjects at grade A, including Mathematics and two sciences, with English Language at grade B or above. Lifeskills Mathematics is excluded. The published Higher-only bypass and Standard Grade alternative remain outside this automatic National 5 route.

a_level.notes: AAA including Biology or Chemistry. General Studies and Critical Thinking are not accepted. Science practical endorsement must be passed where applicable for English awarding bodies.

ib.notes: 34 overall with 6,6,6 at Higher Level including Biology or Chemistry.

grade_requirements.notes: First-sitting S6 route: BBB Advanced Highers including Biology or Chemistry.
First-sitting S6 alternative: AB Advanced Highers including Biology or Chemistry plus one additional Higher at grade A. The three S6 subjects are represented by two Advanced Highers plus one Higher.

manual_review_routes: Advanced Higher resits under UEA's first-sitting BCC/BBD compensation policy.
Applicants using the published AAAAB Higher route because they bypassed National 5 qualifications.
Applicants using Standard Grade / Intermediate 2 evidence in lieu of National 5 qualifications.
Mixed Scottish and A-level combinations that cannot be established from one supported automatic route.
scottish.notes: ApplySmart automatically evaluates UEA's two standard first-sitting S6 Scottish routes when complete National 5 evidence is supplied. Published National 5-bypass, Standard Grade, mixed-qualification and Advanced Higher resit variants remain manual-review boundaries rather than being inferred.

btec.notes: No supported BTEC A100 route is implemented from the supplied evidence.

access_to_he.notes: No supported Access to HE A100 route is implemented from the supplied evidence.

post_16.notes: Academic qualifications are threshold checks only and are not converted into a selection score.

ucat.notes: UEA states that it has no fixed UCAT cut-off. Eligible applicants are ranked by overall UCAT score if interview capacity is oversubscribed.

scoring.notes: SJT is included later in UEA's interview-stage score, but ApplySmart does not predict interview performance or offers.

sjt.notes: Band 3 is not rejected. Band 4 is not implemented as an automatic rejection because the supplied official evidence does not verify that rule.

resits.conditions: A-level resit applicants must meet UEA's published resit policy, including at least one A* in the resat subject(s). GCSE resits must be active and predicted to meet the requirement.
resits.notes: Subject-level resit evidence is not safely represented by the current generic runtime, so resit applicants are routed to manual review.

exemptions: GCSE English Language grade 7/A for International applicants, except specified IGCSE English qualifications requiring IELTS.
english_language.notes: ApplySmart checks IELTS-style component evidence or a declared verified exemption. Listed IGCSE exceptions require manual verification.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Applicants must be aged 18 or over by course start. DBS, occupational health and fitness-to-practise checks are conditions of the professional course.

non_academic.work_experience: Two examples of relevant work experience are required for discussion at interview; not used as a pre-interview selection score in ApplySmart.
non_academic.personal_statement: Checked as non-scored screening information only.
non_academic.reference_policy: Satisfactory reference required as a pass/fail screening item.
non_academic.notes: Personal statement, reference and work-experience examples are not assigned points and do not alter interview guidance.

ranking_factors.notes: Eligible applicants are ranked by overall UCAT score for interview selection when applications exceed interview capacity.

total_score.notes: Runtime guidance uses UCAT total only after eligibility. No GCSE, predicted-grade or SJT points are calculated for interview selection.

calculation.notes: UEA does not publish a fixed current-year UCAT threshold. ApplySmart uses historical-normalised Home guidance only where evidence is usable.

international_selection.notes: Do not claim a separate International UCAT threshold. International-only historical UCAT statistics are an evidence gap.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: No contextual academic reductions, contextual UCAT uplift, contextual scoring or contextual interview threshold are applied to A100.

conditions: Explicit UEA Outreach / Pathways programme evidence is provided in the redesigned Step 6 contextual profile.
Normal UEA A100 minimum entry requirements are met or predicted to be met.
guaranteed_interview_rules.notes: General contextual admissions evidence remains excluded from A100 screening.

contextual_admissions.notes: UEA A100 general contextual policy remains an explicit screening exclusion: non-programme contextual evidence may be collected but does not activate contextual screening, academic reductions or UCAT adjustments. A separate programme-specific guaranteed-interview pathway applies only to confirmed UEA Preparing for Medicine Programme participants who also meet the normal A100 entry requirements. A104 Gateway Medicine is a separate course and is not implemented inside this A100 profile.

ranking_pools.name: Home A100
ranking_pools.notes: 2026 Home place number is subject to confirmation by the Office for Students.

ranking_pools.name: International A100
ranking_pools.notes: Same published method as Home applicants, but International-only historical UCAT guidance is not published.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.

interview_format.duration: 5 minutes per station with 1.5 minutes preparation time

interview_scoring.notes: Interview scoring and SJT contribution are recorded for transparency only.

offer_model.description: UEA states that post-interview ranking uses 50% UCAT and 50% interview score.

standard_offer.ib: 34 overall with 6,6,6 at Higher Level including Biology or Chemistry

offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction, probability of offer, MMI performance prediction and waiting-list prediction are out of scope.

cycles.anomaly_note: UEA FOI_24-267 reports a high value of 1390 and an inverted low/high relationship. Values are preserved verbatim but excluded from automated guidance calibration.

Research reports values above the 2700-point scale. No local source snapshot verified whether these are transcription errors, scale errors or a cycle-label issue, so they are preserved as an evidence discrepancy and excluded from runtime guidance.

historical_admissions.notes: Home 2019-2024 legacy /3600 figures are preserved on their original scale. The 2020 anomaly and unverified 2025 /2700 discrepancy are not used for automated interview-band calibration. International-only historical UCAT statistics are missing.

evidence_gaps: International-only UCAT interview statistics are not published in the supplied evidence.
Country-specific international qualification equivalency tables are not itemised.
UEA 2025 FOI UCAT values reported in the research exceed the stated 2700-point scale and require source-level validation before use.
UEA's National 5-bypass, Standard Grade / Intermediate 2, mixed-qualification and Advanced Higher resit variants remain manual-review boundaries.
known_unknowns: International-only UCAT interview statistics are not published in the supplied evidence.
Country-specific international qualification equivalency tables are not itemised.
UEA 2025 FOI UCAT values reported in the research exceed the stated 2700-point scale and require source-level validation before use.
UEA's National 5-bypass, Standard Grade / Intermediate 2, mixed-qualification and Advanced Higher resit variants remain manual-review boundaries.
validation.review_notes: UEA A100 fits the existing UCAT-ranking architecture without shared-engine changes. The implemented runtime excludes anomalous or unverified historical values from band calibration.

blocking_missing_fields: International-only UCAT historical guidance is unavailable.
Country-specific international qualification equivalencies require UEA verification.
Scottish National 5 grade thresholds require manual review.
2025 UCAT values above the stated /2700 scale require source validation before use.
engine_assumptions: Supported Home A-level and IB applicants are assessed through the generic threshold-eligibility and UCAT-ranking path.
Contextual and widening-participation flags do not alter A100 eligibility or UCAT guidance.
International A100 applicants follow the same published methodology but receive insufficient-evidence interview guidance because International-only historical data is missing.
do_not_infer: Do not create a fixed current-year UCAT threshold.
Do not score GCSEs, predicted grades, personal statement, reference or work experience.
Do not reject SJT Band 3 or Band 4.
Do not apply A104 Gateway or A101 Graduate Entry rules inside A100.
Do not use anomalous 2020 or unverified 2025 historical UCAT values for runtime guidance.
Do not predict offers, interview performance or waiting-list outcomes.
engine_notes.implementation_scope: Eligibility and interview guidance only. No offer, MMI-performance or waiting-list prediction.
standardisation_notes: No contextual A100 adjustment is implemented.
International interview prediction remains unavailable because International-only historical UCAT statistics are missing.
2020 and 2025 anomalous historical UCAT fields are preserved but excluded from runtime calibration.
